title: Rav Yosef son of Rav Nechunya

paragraphs: Rav Yosef son of Rav Nechunya. Mentioned in Berakhot 23b, 25a. He inquired of Rav Yehuda.[^1][^2]

notes.text: בעי מרב יהודה means he inquired of Rav Yehuda: מ marks the person asked, and the older passive alternative is not retained. All three Rav titles are explicit.

כג: gives Berakhot 23b; כה. is rendered 25a by the period convention, although that period also closes the citation sentence. The second amud remains convention-based, without independent named-edition verification.
